def clean(df):
    df['Region'] = df['Region'].fillna('')
    df['Region'] = df['Region'].str.title()
    allowed_regions = ['North', 'South', 'East', 'West']
    df = df[df['Region'].isin(allowed_regions)]

    df['Category'] = df['Category'].fillna('')
    df['Category'] = df['Category'].str.title()
    allowed_categories = ['Electronics', 'Accessories', 'Furniture', 'Office Supplies']
    df = df[df['Category'].isin(allowed_categories)]

    df['Quantity'] = df['Quantity'].astype(int)
    df = df[df['Quantity'] >= 1]

    return df

def answer(df):
    region_sums = {}
    for region in df['Region'].unique():
        total = df[df['Region'] == region]['Quantity'].sum()
        region_sums[region] = total
    return region_sums
